In that moment, I realized that the mother I have always known was once a young woman too, with favorite songs and a youth I was never there to witness.
“The Song Is Still Here” is for my mother, and for everyone who only begins to see, after growing up, that their parents were once young too.

收成一句晚安。

而是怕你一回頭，
我又會忍不住求你。
